# Cumulo UI

> Cumulo is a modern React 19 UI component library and zero-runtime, type-safe CSS framework (`@cumulo/core`, `@cumulo/css`). It enforces platform primitives, compound component composition, tokenized styling, and light-dark theming.

## Instructions for AI coding assistants

When generating or refactoring code using Cumulo, follow these rules:

### 1. Negative layout rules (no arbitrary containers)
- **Never use raw `<div>` for layout, spacing, or flexbox.**
  - Row layouts $\rightarrow$ `<HStack>`
  - Column layouts $\rightarrow$ `<VStack>`
  - Directional or dynamic flexbox $\rightarrow$ `<Stack direction="row" | "column">`
  - Responsive page or section containers $\rightarrow$ `<Container size="sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "full">`
  - Spaced article or document flow $\rightarrow$ `<Flow>`
  - Application frame $\rightarrow$ `<AppFrame>`, `<Panel>`, `<Sidebar>`, `<SideNav>`, `<Header>`

### 2. Negative form rules (compound components only)
- **Never use monolithic input elements (`<Input label="..." error="..." />`).**
- **Always use compound `Field` subcomponents:**
  - `<Field.Root>` coordinates state (`isInvalid`, IDs, accessibility)
  - `<Field.Label>` associates with the input via `htmlFor`
  - `<Field.Input>` and `<Field.Textarea>` inherit invalid intent and accessibility IDs
  - `<Field.Error>` displays validation errors with `role="alert"`
  - `<Field.Description>` provides descriptive text (`aria-describedby`)
  - `<Field.Group>` groups composite radio and checkbox controls

### 3. Negative styling rules (zero Tailwind or inline styles)
- **Never use Tailwind classes, arbitrary CSS utility classes, or inline styles (`style={{ ... }}`).**
- **Always use `@cumulo/css` and design tokens from `vars.*` (`@cumulo/core`):**
  - Static styles: `style({ ... })`
  - Variant styles: `recipe({ base, variants, defaultVariants })`
  - Class composition: `cx(...)`
  - Tokens: `vars.color.*`, `vars.spacing.*`, `vars.radius.*`, `vars.font.*`, `vars.shadow.*`
  - **Never use raw hex, rgb, or hsl strings.** Every color resolves through `vars.color.*`.

### 4. Native top-layer overlays
- **Top-layer overlays**: `<Dialog>` uses native `<dialog>`, `<Popover>` uses native `popover="auto"` with CSS anchor positioning, and `<Tooltip>` uses `<Popover>` with `popover="manual"`. Top-layer overlays render on the platform top layer and are never clipped by parent scroll or `overflow` containers.

### 5. Mandatory self-check loop
Before completing your response, re-read your generated code and verify:
1. Replace any unstyled `<div>` elements with `<Stack>`, `<HStack>`, `<VStack>`, or `<Container>`.
2. Replace any monolithic inputs with compound `<Field.*>` components.
3. Replace any raw colors or inline styles with `@cumulo/css` and `vars.*` tokens.

## Component directory

### App layout
- `AppFrame`: Root layout shell placing a sidebar beside the main column. Subcomponents: `AppFrame.Root`, `AppFrame.Main`.
- `Panel`: Elevated application surface with header, body, and footer sections.
- `Sidebar`: Collapsible sidebar navigation. Subcomponents: `Sidebar.Root`, `Sidebar.Provider`, `Sidebar.Toggle`, `Sidebar.Header`, `Sidebar.Footer`. Hook: `useSidebar()`.
- `SideNav`: Vertical navigation link list. Subcomponents: `SideNav.Root`, `SideNav.Item`, `SideNav.Group`, `SideNav.GroupTrigger`, `SideNav.GroupContent`.
- `Header`: Application top navigation bar.

### Layout and spacing
- `HStack`: Horizontal flex container. Props: `gap`, `align`, `justify`, `wrap`.
- `VStack`: Vertical flex container. Props: `gap`, `align`, `justify`.
- `Stack`: Directional flex container. Props: `direction` ('row' | 'column'), `gap`, `align`, `justify`.
- `Container`: Centered layout wrapper. Props: `size` ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'full'), `padding`.
- `Flow`: Spaced document flow for prose and articles. Props: `gap`.
- `Divider`: Visual separator. Props: `orientation` ('horizontal' | 'vertical').
- `Table`: Tabular layout. Subcomponents: `Table.Root`, `Table.Caption`, `Table.Header`, `Table.Body`, `Table.Row`, `Table.Head`, `Table.Cell`. Props on `Table.Root`: `variant`, `interactive`.

### Forms and input
- `Field`: Compound namespace (`Field.Root`, `Field.Label`, `Field.Input`, `Field.Textarea`, `Field.Checkbox`, `Field.Switch`, `Field.Radio`, `Field.RadioList`, `Field.Error`, `Field.Description`, `Field.Group`).
- `Input`: Standalone text input. Variants: `intent` ('primary' | 'error'), `size` ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg').
- `Textarea`: Standalone multi-line text input.
- `Checkbox`: Accessible native checkbox with label and description.
- `Radio`: Accessible radio item.
- `RadioList`: Group of radio options with roving keyboard focus.
- `Switch`: Toggle switch primitive (`role="switch"`).
- `Label`: Accessible label component (`htmlFor`).

### Overlays (native top-layer)
- `Dialog`: Native HTML5 modal dialog with focus trapping and backdrop. Subcomponents: `Dialog.Root`, `Dialog.Trigger`, `Dialog.Content`, `Dialog.Header`, `Dialog.Title`, `Dialog.Description`, `Dialog.Close`.
- `Popover`: Native `popover="auto"` with CSS anchor positioning. Subcomponents: `Popover.Root`, `Popover.Trigger`, `Popover.Content`.
- `Tooltip`: Native `popover="manual"` tooltip anchored to trigger. Never clipped by scroll boundaries. Subcomponents: `Tooltip.Root`, `Tooltip.Trigger`, `Tooltip.Content`.

### Navigation and tabs
- `Tabs`: Accessible tabs with roving keyboard focus. Subcomponents: `Tabs.Root`, `Tabs.List`, `Tabs.Trigger`, `Tabs.Content`.
- `ButtonGroup`: Connected or segmented button container. Subcomponents: `ButtonGroup.Root`, `ButtonGroup.Item`.

### Feedback and display
- `Button`: Core interactive button. Variants: `variant` ('primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost'), `intent` ('primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'neutral'), `size` ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg').
- `Badge`: Status and counter indicators. Variants: `intent`, `variant` ('solid' | 'subtle' | 'outline'), `size`.
- `Card`: Surface container with border and elevation. Subcomponents: `Card.Header`, `Card.Body`, `Card.Footer`.
- `Surface`: Polymorphic surface with elevation tokens. Props: `level` (0 | 1 | 2 | 3).
- `Collapsible`: Expandable disclosure panel. Subcomponents: `Collapsible.Root`, `Collapsible.Trigger`, `Collapsible.Content`.
- `ThemeToggle`: Accessible dark and light mode toggle button.

### Typography
- `Heading`: Semantic headings (`h1` - `h6`). Props: `as`, `size` ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' | '3xl').
- `Text`: Prose text (`p` or `span`). Props: `as`, `type` ('body' | 'caption' | 'label'), `size`.
- `Code`: Inline code snippet. Props: `variant` ('subtle' | 'solid').

---

## Design tokens cheat sheet (`vars` from `@cumulo/core`)

```ts
import { vars } from '@cumulo/core';

// Colors
vars.color.primary.base;
vars.color.primary.hover;
vars.color.primary.contrast;
vars.color.grey.base;
vars.color.success.base;
vars.color.warning.base;
vars.color.error.base;
vars.color.background.base;
vars.color.surface.base;

// Spacing
vars.spacing.xs;    // 4px
vars.spacing.sm;    // 8px
vars.spacing.md;    // 16px
vars.spacing.lg;    // 24px
vars.spacing.xl;    // 32px
vars.spacing['2xl'];// 48px

// Radii
vars.radius.xs;     // 2px
vars.radius.sm;     // 4px
vars.radius.md;     // 8px
vars.radius.lg;     // 12px
vars.radius.full;   // 9999px

// Typography
vars.font.sans;
vars.font.mono;
vars.font.size.xs;
vars.font.size.sm;
vars.font.size.md;
vars.font.size.lg;
vars.font.size.xl;
```

---

## Styling pattern with `@cumulo/css`

```tsx
import { style, recipe, cx } from '@cumulo/css';
import { vars, HStack, Button } from '@cumulo/core';

const headerStyle = style({
  padding: `${vars.spacing.md} ${vars.spacing.lg}`,
  backgroundColor: vars.color.background.base,
  borderBottom: `1px solid ${vars.color.grey[200]}`,
});

export function Header(): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <header className={headerStyle.className}>
      <HStack justify="between" align="center">
        <Logo />
        <Button variant="primary">Get Started</Button>
      </HStack>
    </header>
  );
}
```
